title: 第11章 上至少妇下至没出生的都不放过第12章 气海巨龙天命之女所在
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
难怪叶雄风的口气如此之大。
不，现在想来，他们简直是太过低调了。
简直是低调的没边儿。
要换做是他们的话，给他们十年，他们就敢让这天香国换主人！
到时只需要满脸慈爱的来一句，“孩子，爷爷这一生如履薄冰，你说我能走到对面吗。”
众人沸腾，尚在惊异的时候。
却在此时，一名萧家族老眼神忽地灵动起来，率先站起来出言道。
“族长，我家刚好有一名女儿家尚且年幼，我觉得配这孩子刚好合适。”
“放屁！老四，你家的孙女都已经七岁了，你要点脸行吗，这孩子才半个月大，你下得去手吗你！？”
转头又是喜笑颜开的建议起来。
“大哥，不如考虑我家的，我家的还小，我第一眼看见天澜就觉得和我家的孙女十分相配，很有夫妻相啊。”
“滚犊子！你又何尝不是出生！你孙女两岁难道就很大吗？”
“呵呵呵，我还是第一次听说加起来不到两岁大的两个孩子可以看出夫妻相的，你才是真的厚颜无耻啊！”
“听我一句劝，武者境界高了，配偶年龄间相差个百来岁都是很正常的事情，何必如此斤斤计较的，更何况还是天澜这孩子。”
“老三，你又想干什么？我警告你不要有非分之想啊，你家的丫头都已经年满二八可以嫁人了，你最好当个人！”
“我家的女儿家怎么就不行了？习武的女子驻颜有加，等天澜稍微长大点都不用等了，直接就娶回家这不好吗？”
“要我说一步到位才好，都不需要干等！”
“而且说不定这孩子就喜欢姐姐呢。”
“什么姐姐，你咋不说给他找妈！”
“一派胡言！靠！！简直是一派胡言！！！我看你们是连脸面都不要了，只有我那儿媳才刚怀孕是最为合适的结婚对象，你们最好都当个人！”

“你又觉得自己行了？还没出生的你也给算上？！”
“你踏马才是畜生啊你！”
只是顷刻之间，原本偌大安静的议事大厅立刻乱作一团。
平日里位高权重的老者一个个争吵的面红耳赤，吵到不服气的时候已经撸起了袖子，大有下一刻就冲出去干架的趋势。
十几名萧家位高权重的族老都是想要举荐自己家的孙女。
更过分的干脆直接就把自己二三十岁的女儿也给算了进去。
为了争抢到这个联姻机会，一个个是争吵的面红脖子粗。
要是让底下人看见他们这副失态的模样，非得震惊到当场瞎了眼不可。
这些老人一个个都跟成精了似的，脸面对于他们来说算什么？
倘若一旦争抢到这个机会的话，自己那一脉毫无疑问将会走向史无前例的巅峰！
这是必然的！
根本没人怀疑叶天澜是否有那个能力。
听到居然有人连三十多岁的女儿也给推荐进来了，叶天澜只感觉头皮发麻不已，脸色当场就黑了，迫切的想要从母亲怀里挣脱出来。
他也不知道这些老毕等到底是给他找结婚对象的，还是给他找妈的。
旁边的叶青山莫名其妙躺枪，被自己媳妇儿给狠狠的瞪了一眼。
他心中不由得直喊冤，这可跟他没有任何关系啊。
“各位不用争了，我孙儿会自己挑选结他的另一半，因此各位只需将合适的人选带来即可。”
看见是自己爷爷开口了，叶天澜瞬间感动的热泪盈眶。
还好有你啊，爷爷···
content_en:
No wonder Ye Xiongfeng's tone was so loud.
No, thinking about it now, they were simply too low-key.
It's simply low-key and borderless.
If it were them, given ten years, they would dare to let Tianxiang Kingdom change its owner!
At that time, all you need to do is say with a loving face, "My child, Grandpa is walking on thin ice in this life. Do you think I can walk to the other side?"
Everyone was excited, still in shock.
But at this moment, the eyes of an elder from the Xiao family suddenly became alert, and he stood up first and spoke.
"Patriarch, my family happens to have a daughter who is still young. I think this child is just right for her."
"Fart! Fourth child, your granddaughter is already seven years old. Can you please show some respect? This child is only half a month old. Can you do it?"
He turned around and suggested with a smile again.
"Brother, why don't you consider my family? My family is still young. When I first saw Tianlan, I thought she would be a perfect match for my granddaughter. She looks like a good couple."
"Go away! Why weren't you born? Isn't your granddaughter very big at the age of two?"
"Hahaha, this is the first time I've heard that two children who are less than two years old together can tell the appearance of a couple. You are really shameless!"
"Listen to my advice. As a warrior reaches a higher level, it is normal for spouses to have an age difference of more than a hundred years. Why should we be so fussy about it, let alone a child like Tianlan."
"Third brother, what do you want to do? I warn you not to have any unreasonable thoughts. Your girls are already over 28 years old and can get married. You'd better be a human being!"
"Why can't my daughter's family be good? The women who practice martial arts are so beautiful. I don't have to wait until Tianlan grows up a little, and just marry her home. Wouldn't it be better?"
"If you want me to say, it's just one step, there's no need to wait!"
"And maybe this kid likes his sister."
"What sister, why didn't you tell him to find a mother for him!"
"What a load of nonsense! Damn! It's a load of nonsense!!! I think you guys don't even care about face. Only my daughter-in-law, who is just pregnant, is the most suitable candidate for marriage. You'd better be human beings!"
"You think you can do it again? Are you counting those who haven't been born yet?!"
"You are a beast when you step on a horse!"
Just in an instant, the originally large and quiet meeting hall immediately became chaotic.
The old men who usually held high positions were all red-faced when arguing. When they were not convinced, they had already rolled up their sleeves, and there was a strong tendency to rush out and fight at the next moment.
More than a dozen high-ranking elders of the Xiao family wanted to recommend their own granddaughters.
To go even further, he might as well include his daughter who is in her twenties and thirties.
In order to compete for this marriage opportunity, everyone was quarreling red-faced and thick-necked.
If the people below saw them losing their composure, they would be so shocked that they would be blinded on the spot.
Each of these old people seems to have become a spirit. What does face mean to them?
If you seize this opportunity, your lineage will undoubtedly reach an unprecedented peak!
This is inevitable!
No one doubted whether Ye Tianlan had that ability.
Hearing that someone even recommended a daughter in her thirties, Ye Tianlan felt his scalp numb, his face darkened on the spot, and he desperately wanted to break free from his mother's arms.
He didn't know whether these old men were looking for him to marry or to find his mother.
Next to him, Ye Qingshan was lying on his back for no apparent reason, and was glared at by his wife.
He couldn't help but cry out for injustice, but this had nothing to do with him.
"No need to argue, my grandson will choose the other half of the guitar himself, so all you have to do is bring the right person."
Seeing that it was his grandfather who spoke, Ye Tianlan was moved to tears.
Fortunately, I have you, Grandpa...
